name: @feldspar/payments
title: Payments
description: Take payments in your applications through a payment provider, and react to them with your own triggers.
supplies: Three tables: pay_accounts (one per configured provider, with its keys kept secret), pay_objects (a mirror of the provider's checkouts, payments and customers) and pay_events (one row per thing that happened, for your triggers to react to).
Payments through Stripe, or through a test provider ("fake") with a checkout page of its own, so payment screens can be built before anybody has a provider account.
Webhooks for each account's provider events, processed once each into pay_events, and a sweep that catches any the provider failed to deliver.
Actions to take a payment for a row of your own tables (pay_checkout), to refund one, to call the provider's API, and to try an account with a small test checkout.
